purpose: Record live Figma routing evidence before promoting reviewed project routes to READY_FOR_DELIVERY.

method.readback: Figma metadata readback of the exact Generated Assets frame in each registered file.
method.write_smoke: Create a temporary 32x32 frame inside Generated Assets, create a deterministic PNG image from Uint8Array bytes, assign it as an IMAGE fill, read the stored raw image back, then delete the temporary frame.
method.cleanup: Each temporary smoke node was removed and its delivery area was checked for zero remaining nodes with the smoke name.

claim_ceiling: This proves the registered Figma files and exact delivery nodes were readable and mutable through the connected Figma execution path on the verification date.
This proves a deterministic sample PNG could be written and read back in every registered project file without leaving the temporary smoke node behind.
This does not prove OpenAI/provider image generation quality or provider availability.
This does not prove that the local Tool Hub directly uploads to Figma without the connected project GPT/Figma execution layer.
This does not approve generated art for use in the game or prove in-game Godot integration.
